SELECT t.id, t.name, t.status_enum AS statusEnum, t.type_enum AS typeEnum, ( SELECT c.price_value FROM adm_charge_item_definition c WHERE c.instance_table = 'wkf_activity_definition' AND c.instance_id = t.id AND c.price_type_code = 'SALE' AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(c.priority, 2147483647), c.id LIMIT 1 ) AS price FROM wkf_activity_definition t
t.is_deleted = 0
AND (t.bus_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.py_str LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.wb_str LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND t.category_code = #{query.categoryCode}
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
